title: Elodie and the Archive
author: Casper Yarrow
blurb: Yara Underhill, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
